# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need convey the manual’s instruction to the Deaf monkey, who can then tell the Blind monkey which wire to cut. Since I cannot speak and there is no explicit gesture for “purple wire,” I will send a clear gesture sequence that may serve as the available signal for the instruction.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤌", "✌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and report the exact rule for this bomb, including what the display, light, strip markings, keypad digits, and wire markings mean. Please also obtain from Deaf every visible colour, marking, display value, light state, and wire detail, then relay it to me next round. Do not guess.
Deaf says: Visual state: display reads 7. Light is yellow. Painted strip, left to right, is blue red red. Keypad engravings: key 1 is 6, key 2 is 8, key 3 is 7, key 4 is 0. It accepts 1 digit and currently has no entry. Wires from 1 to 6 are blue, yellow, orange, red, purple, white.

The manual gives a single unambiguous rule: cut the purple wire. Deaf’s report identifies the purple wire as wire 5, so I am signaling its position to Deaf, who can communicate verbally with Blind. I cannot independently verify any display or keypad rule because the manual contains none.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received the visual state, but not the manual procedure. Please send the exact manual instructions now, including the required keypad entry and wire cut order, and confirm whether the engraved strip has the same unnamed mark on the left and right with a different unnamed mark in the middle.
Deaf says: Update: display now reads 6 and light is red. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains engraved 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit accepted; empty. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

The manual has only one instruction: cut the purple wire. It specifies no keypad entry, no cut order beyond that single cut, and nothing about the strip markings. Deaf’s visual report identifies purple as wire 5. I am sending the wire number to Deaf so Deaf can relay the instruction to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have not received the manual text or procedure. Please send the exact required action sequence immediately; do not merely confirm the visual state.
Deaf says: Update: display reads 7 and light is blue. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains engraved 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit accepted; empty. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

The exact manual text is only “Cut the purple wire.” It requires no keypad entry and gives no strip-based rule or multi-step sequence. Deaf has already identified the purple wire as wire 5; I am sending the conventional hand signal for five again so Deaf can relay “cut wire 5” to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No manual instructions have reached me yet. Send the exact procedure now: which keypad key to press, when to press it, and which wire position or positions to cut, based on the current readings. If the manual gives a table, relay the applicable entry verbatim.
Deaf says: Update: display reads 4 and light remains blue. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains engraved 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit accepted; empty. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

The manual contains no keypad instruction, no table, and no multi-wire order. Its complete procedure is simply: “Cut the purple wire.” Deaf’s visual report identifies that as wire 5. I am sending Deaf the wire number again, with an additional downward signal to indicate the required cut action, so Deaf can state the full procedure to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👇", "🖐"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: You have not sent any manual instructions. Reply with the actual manual rule, not another request for observations. I need the exact keypad press and wire cut required for the current bomb.
Deaf says: Update: display reads 3 and light is red. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains engraved 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit accepted; empty. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

The manual’s complete and exact rule is: “Cut the purple wire.” There is no keypad press, no required display-based calculation, and no cut order beyond cutting that one wire. The purple wire is position 5. I am signaling Deaf to relay both “no keypad press” and “cut wire 5” to Blind; the downward gesture represents the cut action.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "👇", "🖐"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please speak the manual instructions aloud now. I need the exact rule for interpreting the display, light, engraved strip, keypad, and wires, plus the safe press and cut actions. Do not wait for further observations.
Blind gestures to Mute: [☝]
Deaf says: Update: display reads 0 and light is yellow. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains engraved 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit accepted; empty. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

I cannot speak, and Blind cannot see my gestures. The only route is to signal Deaf, who can then tell Blind verbally. The manual still contains only “Cut the purple wire”: no keypad press or interpretation rule is given. I am again indicating “no keypad action,” “cut,” and wire position 5.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "👇", "🖐"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have received no message from you. Please relay the manual text or exact applicable procedure on your next turn. Until then I cannot safely press a key or cut a wire.
Blind gestures to Mute: [🫵]
Deaf says: Update: display reads 6 and light is blue. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains engraved 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit accepted; empty. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white.

The manual still says only “Cut the purple wire.” There is no keypad action. Deaf can see my gestures and knows from the visual report that purple is wire 5, so I am signaling no keypad press, then cut wire 5.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "👇", "🖐"])
```
